paragraph1: Hello! I’m Seyed Meyssam Hosseinifard, a Fullstack Developer with over 8 years of experience specializing in React, Next.js, and Node.js. I hold a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and speak fluent German. I am passionate about building high-performance, scalable web applications with a strong focus on Clean Code and modern UI/UX principles.
paragraph2: I believe that great software is where beautiful design meets robust engineering. I thrive on solving complex challenges, from optimizing REST APIs and managing databases to ensuring seamless user experiences that perform flawlessly under the hood.
paragraph3: I am always looking for the next big challenge. If you are seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented developer ready to bring your vision to life, I would love to connect. Let's collaborate and turn your ideas into reality.
